what: A small dot inside the big circle (moon) attached to the screen center slides to the center of a header or footer menu letter on hover over .5s power2.out and turns on, and on release it turns off in place over .5s. The dot color is the link’s --fx-dot (a pale board color over the light header, a dark color over the black footer) — if the circle is blended as overlay, the dot also shows through faintly.

options.targets: Link the dot follows (CSS selector), default [data-fx-part=target] — may sit outside the stage (header · footer)
options.--fx-dot: Dot color — set on the link (or its ancestor), default --kf-raised

use:
·
…
note: Don’t attach on finger-screen devices (no hover)
